events.title: Apple announces the iPhone
events.description: A touchscreen device combines phone, music and internet functions.

events.title: The financial crisis intensifies
events.description: Lehman Brothers files for bankruptcy. Authorities support other financial firms as stress spreads.

events.title: Deepwater Horizon disaster
events.description: An offshore drilling explosion kills workers and leads to a major oil spill.

what_happened_next.text: Disney led these choices, while Toyota lost value. Bonds gained more than either broad share basket. The five years included the financial crisis, which made the journey difficult even for investments that finished higher. Strong business news at the start did not guarantee a strong stock return.

reflection.what_people_were_focused_on: Katrina recovery, energy supplies and competition in cars and entertainment were prominent concerns.
reflection.what_actually_mattered: The mix of assets mattered through a severe financial shock. A famous company could finish below its starting value while a government-bond estimate gained.
reflection.what_faded_away: A record earnings announcement described a past quarter, not the next five years. A confident new leader also had no control over every event ahead.
reflection.what_nobody_knew: The crisis and the exact investment ranking were unknown. Today’s chart makes a difficult period look much simpler than it was.
